modes.label: Pigment
modes.description: Mixes the layer into what is below like paint, by its opacity: blue and yellow make green.

modes.label: Watercolor
modes.description: A transparent wash: the colours filter each other wavelength by wavelength, so layers darken like glazes and blue over yellow gives green. White is clear.

modes.label: Tint
modes.description: Tints what is below with the layer's colour and keeps its lightness; mid-tones take the full tint, highlights and darks stay clean.

modes.label: Highlight
modes.description: Adds the layer as coloured light that rolls off softly towards white instead of clipping. Black adds nothing.

modes.label: Shadow
modes.description: Shades what is below as if the layer blocked the light, coloured by the layer, with ambient light so it never crushes to black. White does nothing.
